text:
alex: Pushing up a canary perf alert — 95p latency up ~12% on master post-merge 8b7a2c4.
perf-bot: CI perf suite: canary-int8-1024 test failed. baseline p95 380ms -> canary p95 425ms (+11.8%).
ci-bot: Regression detected in perf/inference/latency. Saw token throughput drop 9%.
maria: Copying flamegraph link: https://internal.prof/fg/2418001234 :eyes: Looks like dequant_loop and kernel_dispatch are heavier.
sam: Starting git bisect on runtime/master..release/2026-03-16
sam: git bisect start; git bisect bad HEAD; git bisect good v2026-03-15
sam: Found candidate: commit 8b7a2c4 — "scheduler: add quant-compatibility hint to kernel selector"
alex: That change added a new "compat_hint" that nudges kernel selector to prefer generic kernels for compatibility with mixed precision. Might be selecting a dequantizing path.
maria: Profile snippet: 
```
95th: 425ms
  dequant_loop 35%
  kernel_dispatch 22%
  kv_cache_lookup 9%
  batch_coalesce 8%
```
maria: Heap/allocs show extra memcpy between dequant buffers during batching.
nora: Reproduced locally with int8 profile + small batch sizes. Repro steps:
```
python bench.py --model x --profile int8 --seq 1024 --batch 4
```
nora: If I force kernel_selector to prefer fused-dequant kernels p95 drops back to 370ms.
alex: Looks like the new compat hint makes selector choose the non-fused path for INT8 on certain shapes which inserts dequant->compute->requant cycles inside the batch loop.
sam: Proposed mitigations:
- revert commit 8b7a2c4 (fastest, rollback canary)
- patch selector to respect fused_fallback for int8 shapes
- add CI perf test for this shape+batch size
maria: Also noticed KV cache thrash: repeated dequant -> kv_lookup -> requant causes more cache misses because buffers bounce.
releases: Hold rollout for the merge and open revert PR. Flagging as rollout-blocker.
alex: I'll open the revert PR now and attach perf traces.
perf-bot: Perf tests queued for revert PR #4123
ci-bot: perf job #78234: baseline vs revert (running)
sam: After revert locally p95 returns to 378ms. Dequant_loop down to 6%.
maria: We'll add a unit to kernel selector tests to cover preferring fused-dequant for int8 path.
releases: Thx — earmark for hotfix release tomorrow, and add note to release notes about kernel selector variance for quantized paths.
alex: TL;DR: merge 8b7a2c4 introduced a quant-compat hint that caused non-fused kernel selection leading to heavy dequant overhead and KV cache thrash. Revert in flight. :shipit:
